facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: fire on ML-3202 during a planned shutdown

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control LOAD_SUPPORT_FOR_MAINTENANCE: the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access had been bypassed, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control PARK_UP_AND_RESTRAINT: the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Restore the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access on ML-3202 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in planning and permitting an isolation, specifically identifying every energy source for a task. ML-3202 (grinding mills) is in service for two-line ball milling. The task proceeded during a planned shutdown while the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access had been bypassed. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 25 February 2012 an incident occurred on ML-3202 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during a planned shutdown, releasing kinetic energy held as rotating equipment.
